scope: Typed synthetic iOS subject fixtures, six equivalent legacy database collection reads, one unused note helper and a common native grouped SwiftUI Home. No account, schema, query, grading, outbox, API token, transport or curriculum-format change.

lineCounts.productionScope: Physical lines in app-owned tracked/new App/**/*.swift and Shared/Sources/**/*.swift; excludes Pods, Tests, AppTests, AppStoreScreenshots, FontScreenshotter and the two owner-only annotated files. Includes all changed production files, not merely deleted/moved ones. Test, resource and documentation lines are reported separately, not hidden as production Swift.

fixtureEquivalence.method: Evaluate original Swift multiline literals, decode original protobuf text, construct final formatted Swift values, compare SwiftProtobuf equality and serializedData bytes. Includes optional-field presence and ordered repeated fields. Temporary verifier compiled with the existing generated schema and local SwiftProtobuf product through Mainboard; no temporary conversion tool added to the app.

runtimeWarnings.message: [Internal] Thread running at User-interactive quality-of-service class waiting on a lower QoS thread running at Default quality-of-service class. Investigate ways to avoid priority inversions

contrastRegression.result: Visually verified: blue inherited symbols were low contrast/invisible on colored buttons; the explicit white foreground renders active lesson/review symbols clearly; disabled buttons use the system primary foreground and retain native disabled dimming.

testScope: The full seven-case phone/tablet grouped-layout gates passed before the final presentation-only foreground-contrast corrections. Final Home/rotation cases rerun the corrected source on each simulator; final native, shared and Release evidence uses the corrected source. The 93 hosted integration functions preceded the final disabled-label presentation refinement; all covered legacy storage, archive, account and media source files were unchanged. Fixture values, queries and grading logic did not change between these runs.
visualReview: Inspected light and dark app-window Home screenshots: grouped native section surfaces, centered readable wide layout, Lessons/Reviews remain first, forecast and extra study retain their order, WaniKani subject colors and existing glass controls remain. Phone/tablet gate includes rotation, empty/limited/vacation queues and existing study/catalog/Coverage routes.
limits: This is a cleanup checkpoint, not completion of the full SwiftUI/native iOS migration.
Live iOS SQLite and read-only schema 9–15 import remain required. No uncertain submissions were replayed; all UI exercises use synthetic fixtures.
JSON remains the WaniKani wire and bundled curriculum/preview format; response fixtures remain for protocol/recovery acceptance.
Native automatic upload of confirmed saved work is still open; the current native app requires explicit Saved work sync.
Physical-device speech, IME, notifications, paired-watch delivery, full-account statistics and hosted Actions remain separate gates.
Mac UI results retain an internal thread-priority runtime warning. Release diagnostics are incremental build evidence, not a whole-project warning audit.
unrelatedRootAndMainboardChanges: Untouched; no parent repository commit, new task alias, pull request or push.
